As designated by its title, the text treats the intersection of the *Kusalattika* (the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states) with the *Atītārammaṇattika* (the triad of states taking past, future, or present phenomena as their objects) within the formal matrix of conditional relations (*paccaya*) characteristic of the *Paṭṭhāna* [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
